specs.prompt:
Edit the FIRST input into a finished full-screen LANDSCAPE individual character-selection UI for the Chinese co-op game 交子赶工记. EXACT COMPOSITION LOCK: user says 参考上次构图，只是变换风格，视觉语言规范要统一；底下绿色改为红棕色. Keep all original locations/proportions and clear negative space: narrow four-head vertical rail at far left, one large full-body character at center taking 60% height, two overlapping inclined illustrated tool cards at lower-left of character, huge two-character calligraphic name on upper-right, ONE short skill line under name, bottom-center 选择 [F] paper button under character, bottom-left P1 待选 and P2 已备, subdued disabled 入坊 at bottom-right, small back arrow upper-left.
CRITICAL COLOR CHANGE: change the entire connected green area on lower ground and left sidebar to warm REDDISH CHESTNUT BROWN #713F30, with a slightly lighter #8F5140 angular paper overlap at its sloping boundary. It must be noticeably red-brown, not green, not purple, not muddy grey. Retain the same diagonal silhouette extent of that lower/left area; do not add new borders/panels. Upper and right are calm warm ivory #F4E6C6. Keep the few distant timber-workshop shapes extremely faint warm beige on ivory. Eliminate busy foliage/grain/rough brush fills. Do NOT recolor the character's teal sash or clothes; P1 remains TEAL and P2 remains VERMILION independent from background. Tiny supporting card landscape may use muted teal.
New visual language: thoughtful geometric CUT-PAPER COLLAGE. The new character sheet reference is the required character design: broad folded polygon shapes, clear angular ears/muzzle/clothes/limbs, few structural colored planes, little/no black contour, very short paper-layer shadows. Joyful expressive animal, flat dimensional paper cutout integrated in collage, not plastic/furry 3D, no traditional rough ink outlines or brush-painted fur. Avoid arbitrary triangular tessellation, chips, noise. Limited very faint paper tooth is okay; color areas clean, no dirty paper.
Left rail icons in EXACT order top to bottom otter, golden monkey, giant panda, red panda: four simple warm-ivory HEAD SILHOUETTE SEALS within thin ivory circular frames on redbrown rail. Negative spaces for species; angular but legible. No detailed portrait/watercolor heads. Head shape must distinguish roundear broad muzzle otter; large roundear tuft monkey; round ears eye patches panda; pointedear broad cheek redpanda. Focus is a thin ochre ring. P1 badge teal circle with ivory P1, P2 vermilion diamond with ivory P2 and small tick, never gold badges. Name/skill clear dark brown brush typography identical to old positions. No more text or extra stats. Primary 选择 [F] cream clipped-corner paper with thin redbrown rule and short shadow, no gold ornament. Disabled 入坊 desaturated warmgrey paper. All elements match same paper thickness, clipping and shadow direction. No humans, cards with rarity, invented skills, layout changes, full-body companions, weapons or extra paragraphs. Preserve original 16:9 frame.
First image is layout edit target, second image is the NEW required otter character; third is cut-paper material/style only; fourth is this same game's new overview for consistency of character, P1/P2 and clean UI. Keep the source pose: confident female OTTER gesturing one hand and holding thin tall bamboo papermaking sieve with other, blue earbow, orange brown with cream muzzle, indigo robe amber trim teal sash, thick tapering tail behind left leg. Scale and place exactly as original. Do not borrow dog from style image3.
Right text EXACTLY 泡泡 and 抄纸 1.4秒.
Keep two lower-left tilted cards in their original footprints: left shows bamboo sieve, right wet paper raised from water vat, now geometric paper illustrations with simple quiet backgrounds, not a skill deck.
First left icon focus ring and P1; third panda icon P2 tick. Bottom P1 待选 / P2 已备. This is a BROWSING/NOT-YET-CHOSEN state for player1, so keep 选择 [F] and disabled 入坊. Do not turn this into the four-character overview.

specs.prompt:

This is one member of a four-screen matched set; preserve every layout and component detail, camera, dimensions, font style, scale, negative space, tool card positions, four-icon rail, lower buttons and TWO-COLOR BACKGROUND exactly. The user explicitly requires original layout with unified language.
CRITICAL: Keep the master’s smooth CONTINUOUS gently curved diagonal edge between the flat warm RED-BROWN #713F30 area at left/bottom and ivory #F4E6C6 at right/top. The user rejected jagged/stair-stepped edges, pale folded strips and chunky notches. Do not reintroduce them, do not turn background green or change its occupied area. Keep this quiet continuous redbrown plane, minimal shadow, no paper border ornament. Leave the calm pale timber-building silhouettes in the ivory area.
ONLY change main character to the one specified from image2; right large name and ONE short skill; subjects inside the TWO existing inclined illustration cards; correct which left icon carries P1 focus and P2 ready. Keep same order of ALL four side head stamps, otter/monkey/panda/redpanda, with same appearance across all screens. They are simple cream head silhouettes within thin cream rings, not full portraits. P1 teal circle, P2 vermilion diamond, both white labels; focus ochre outline. Bottom same P1 待选 and P2 已备, under character 选择 [F], bottom right disabled 入坊, top-left back arrow. Do not add a second hero, four-overview, description panel, stats, extra buttons, or other skills.
Style main character and two card artworks as the same geometric cut-paper collage of image2: deliberate faceted ears/muzzle/robe, broad saturated paper colors, angular simplified paws, short paper-layer shadows, little/no black contour. Cute animal, not a furry/CGI/plastic sculpture or rough ink-painted figure. No random micro-triangles, grain, stains or small decorative noise. Anatomy clean, hands/paws connect naturally to held objects; feet stand on redbrown plane above selection button. Match the main subject's position and approximate width/height to image1 while honoring species silhouette. Keep costume colors and identifying species features of image2. Use original 16:9 landscape, clear Chinese text.
Hero is 递蕉, male golden snub-nosed monkey, large ROUND ears and orange golden upward tuft, cool blue-grey cheeks, green robe cream sleeves, red sash/scarf, long THIN curl tail. Exact geometric character from second image. Energetic passing gesture, one extended paw holds ONE sheet, opposite paw behind. Right name EXACT 递蕉, skill EXACT 递交 2米. Two cards: left one single cream Jiaozi sheet with red small seal, right two ANIMAL paws passing one sheet (not human hands), quiet paper-workshop landscapes. P1 teal badge and gold focus ring on SECOND monkey head; P2 red diamond+tick on THIRD panda. All other master components unchanged.
